name: fw-build-your-mcp-server
description: Build your own MCP server on Freshworks Platform 3.0: actions.json, SMI serverless handlers, request templates, validation, and integration checklists.

interface.shortDescription: MCP server: actions.json, SMI handlers, request templates, and third-party APIs.
